_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own values. Never commit config.json — it holds credentials.

router._comment: Reboot support. method: 'none' | 'ssh' | 'http'. Leave as 'none' if you don't want remote reboot wired up.
router._ssh_comment: Used when method is 'ssh'. Runs `command` over SSH on the router/OpenWRT box.
router._http_comment: Used when method is 'http'. Some routers (e.g. some ASUS/Ubiquiti/pfSense setups) expose a reboot endpoint.

vpn._comment: Optional. method: 'none' | 'command'. 'command' runs a local shell command on the agent machine, e.g. a WireGuard up/down script.
